- [ ] Admin Authentication / Settings
- [ ] Web Audio Sound Engine
- [ ] Manifest Print Output

- Component Type: (e.g., Brain, Radio, Optical, Distance, Inertial, Rotational, Solenoids)

- Team Involved: (e.g., `654K`, `654J`, `654A`, `654B`, `654G`, `654T`, `654V`, `654Y`, `654X`, `654Z`, `654W`, `RECF`)
- Admin Mode Active: (Yes / No)

If applicable, press `D` or click the Activity icon to open System Diagnostics, and attach a screenshot or diagnostic JSON summary.
